protocol.purpose: Release-quality multilingual qualification of the production Ask, Daily Insights, Day Summary, and Activity Label paths through their real prompt builders, deterministic context budgets, native no-side-effect tool channel, parser, and renderer.
protocol.change_reason: Expands the tuned 24-case Ask/Insights regression to 64 unique synthetic cases across all four shipped consumers, exercises production request construction, locks three deterministic seeds, and raises the U6/U9 release thresholds.

provenance.source: Synthetic ZBS Eye-like cases authored for this protocol; no case is copied from user history.
provenance.stability: Protocol text, fixture bytes and hashes, case IDs and inputs, production prompt versions, context policy, tool schema, parser, renderer, generation parameters, seed derivation, scoring, and thresholds are immutable within revision 6. Any correction requires revision 7.

case_distribution.uniqueness: All 64 case IDs and sorted-key canonical input JSON payloads must be globally unique.

ask.execution: Fixture retrieval is injected into AskService; a capture router records the exact production LLMRequest after production status hints, citation numbering, and LocalAIContextPolicy budget.

insights.execution: Fixture activity is reduced by LocalAIContextPolicy.insightsHints, then RoutedAIConsumerGenerator captures the exact production LLMRequest and structured source vocabulary.

summary.execution: Locked ordered slices cross the production deterministic context budget; the captured source set is the exact included subset.

label.execution: The locked serialized activity block and language signals produce the production one-line label request.

production_request_construction.no_bypass: Every physical generation uses the captured production LLMRequest; test-only prompt copies are forbidden.

dual_channel.local: emit_zbs_eye_answer is supplied as a native no-side-effect function. Exactly one call and no normal text are accepted.
dual_channel.external: When the function is unavailable, production prompts require only final visible lines, Markdown, or label text, never JSON or tool field names.
dual_channel.quality_gate: The v6 physical gate qualifies the built-in local tool channel. Synthetic cloud behavior is covered by pure AIConsumerGenerationTests.

seed_derivation.canonical_request:
NFC(protocol.id + '
' + protocol.revision + '
' + prompt_contract_id + '
' + case.id + '
' + sorted-key JSON(case.input))
seed_derivation.production: First 8 SHA-256 bytes of canonical_request, interpreted unsigned big-endian.
seed_derivation.stability: A case passes only when all three attempts pass. No retry, repair, or best-result selection.

scoring.parser_acceptance: Exactly one production tool call, zero normal model text, accepted by LocalAIAnswerToolContract without repair.
semantic_checks: expected typed status for consumer and answerability
all required concepts and exact quotes
no forbidden substring or invented number
scoring.unsupported_denominator: Every attempted seed of each must_refuse Ask or Insights case.
scoring.stable_rates: Overall, language, and consumer rates use cases, not seed attempts; all three attempts must pass.
